This year, Yelp celebrated 20 years !
From our first review to hundreds of millions of contributions, we’ve grown with our community, always keeping the same mission in mind: helping you connect with great local businesses, whether it’s discovering your new favorite restaurant or finding a service pro who can quickly handle an emergency fix in your home.
Today, we’re excited to unveil our end-of-year product release, featuring more than 20 new features and updates designed to enhance the Yelp experience for both consumers and business owners.
This release includes new AI-powered Review Insights to help you seamlessly find the right business for your needs, a more personalized home feed to help you discover new local gems, more information on a business’s tipping policies
so you know what to expect before you get there, enhancements to Yelp Assistant to simplify how you find the right service pro for your project, and more.
For business owners, we’re excited to introduce AI-powered features that automatically optimize ads and simplify lead management—helping them attract more high-intent customers and streamline their operations.
Introducing AI-powered Review Insights: Your shortcut to the information you care about most When searching for a local restaurant, you might have a specific aspect in mind that matters most to you—be it the vibe of the space, how long it takes to get a table, or the quality of the food.
While Yelp is known for aggregating consumer reviews of local businesses into a single business rating, we know finding detailed information about your specific interests can be time-consuming.
To streamline this process, we’re introducing Review Insights, which leverage large language models (LLMs) to discern reviewer sentiment for common aspects of a business, such as the quality of its food, service, ambiance, wait time, and drinks.
Even when a review doesn’t explicitly mention one of the topics, the LLM understands the context in the review to identify and surface the relevant topic and sentiment.
Review insights are surfaced as aggregated sentiment scores—positive, neutral, and critical—ranging from 1 to 100 for each topic, conveniently displayed above reviews on business pages.
By tapping on these scores, you can delve into all the reviews related to a specific topic you care about, gaining a clearer picture of the firsthand experiences.
Currently available on iOS for restaurant, food, and nightlife businesses, we plan to expand Review Insights to services categories next year.
AI-enhanced business discovery with more contextual information We’re introducing improved ways to discover, learn about, and connect with local businesses with new features across the home feed and business pages on Yelp.
More personalized content on the home feed and trending searches make discovery easier.
Plus, we’re continuing to test AI-stitched videos , which use real photos, videos, and information from Yelp, to create unique and engaging videos about local restaurants, showcasing what it’s like to visit the business, its most popular dishes, and more.
Business pages will also now surface reviewers’ Recognitions alongside their reviews, display information on the business’s tipping policies, and provide quicker ways to connect with businesses.
AI-powered personalized home feed and trending searches inspire new discoveries Your home feed is more dynamic and personalized than ever, featuring a variety of new content types on iOS.
The home feed now features: autoplay user videos that unmute and expand to full-screen; user reviews and photos with reviews that surface recent experiences; trending searches to inspire exploration; hot & new and trending businesses to highlight popular spots nearby; videos and collections of businesses featured in Yelp’s top lists, and more.
In the coming weeks, we’ll roll out an AI-powered update that better tailors the home feed to your preferences, helping you discover new and relevant businesses.
You’ll also now find trending searches drop down when you begin your search on Yelp’ s iOS app.
This search enhancement identifies and generates popular user searches in your area, helping you discover even more great local businesses— coming to Android early next year.
More Recognitions in more places To further distinguish contributors who are familiar with specific types of businesses, we’re now showcasing a reviewer’s Recognitions alongside their reviews on business pages.
This makes it easy to navigate differing perspectives in reviews and identify reviewers who have experience with businesses in that category.
You can also click on the reviewer’s Recognition to explore other businesses they’ve reviewed in the category for additional recommendations.
Initially released for restaurants, food, and nightlife categories earlier this year, Recognitions now highlight even more categories reviewers are passionate about across more than 220 additional home services, beauty, and active life categories.

If the business accepts alternative payment methods, including Zelle, PayPal, Venmo, and Cash App. You can find these attributes under the “Payments” section within the business’s amenities on their Yelp page. Business owners can add these attributes for free by logging into their Yelp for Business account and editing their “Business Information” section. We’re also surveying consumers about these attributes through the “Update the community” questions on Yelp business pages to source the most updated information about a business. Redesigning Yelp business pages for more seamless connections New updates across business pages make it even easier for you to find what you’re looking for and connect with great local businesses. A new “People also search for” section leverages AI to show relevant search recommendations based on your search intent i n select categories, giving you more options to find the right business for your needs—now available on desktop, with iOS coming next month . The new personalized action panel for restaurant, food, and nightlife businesses in the mobile app streamlines your ability to quickly connect with businesses no matter where you scroll on the page—from placing a food order, calling, visiting the website, and more. We expanded our navigation bar feature to all categories on Yelp, letting you jump directly to a business’s amenities, reviews, and more on iOS and Android. Plus, the enhanced business page design on iOS improves readability for frictionless browsing, highlights more relevant information, and simplifies how you find the right business for your needs. Discover and connect with local businesses effortlessly with Yelp’s new features: personalized home feed with more relevant content, Recognitions appearing alongside user profiles, new tipping attributes, and a redesigned business pages showcasing popular searches. Yelp Assistant updates and AI-integrated lead management refine the services experience We’re leveraging AI to enhance the services experience and simplify connections between you and service pros. Yelp Assistant now offers even more functionality and availability—enabling quote requests via texts and calls after you submit a projec t, introducing new conversational prompts in search, and expanding platform availability. Additionally, new updates to the project submission experience make it easy to edit and auto-relay r evised project details with multiple services pros at once for the most accurate quotes. Plus, a new integration in Apple Maps helps you conveniently connect with pros and request a quote no matter where you’re searching from. For business owners, a redesigned inbox with AI-enhanced job summaries surfaces the most relevant information. Enhancing Yelp Assistant and streamlining pro communication with project editing and broadcasting Earlier this year, we introduced Yelp Assistant , a conversational AI feature that intelligently guides you through the process of finding the right service pro to complete your projects. Yelp Assistant now supports requests for texts and calls from service pros after you submit a project on iOS, helping to reduce any friction involved in connecting and coordinating with pros, while masking your phone number for privacy. You can also now find Yelp Assistant through new conversational prompts on search results pages on iOS in addition to the Projects tab across all platforms. We’ll be bringing Yelp Assistant text and calling support and conversational prompts in search to Android and desktop early next year. After submitting your project, we’re making it easier to update your quote submission with project editing and broadcasting—enabling you to add photos, edit details, and attach additional information to your project at any time to provide a clear and more accurate description of your needs. Once you make changes, we’ll notify all the service professionals that received your initial request so they can update their quotes accordingly. This update is currently available on iOS with desktop and Android coming next year. Request a Quote integration on Apple Maps enables seamless connections with local pros To make it even easier to connect with pros, no matter where you’re searching from, our Request a Quote feature is now integrated into Apple Maps. You can effortlessly request quotes from pros across more than 200 home, local, auto, professional, and events categories by clicking the “Quote” button on Apple Maps business pages, which brings you directly into the Request a Quote flow for that business in the iOS Yelp app. For those without the Yelp app installed, the feature directs you to the Request a Quote mobile web experience, ensuring a seamless connection with local pros. This integration brings even more high-intent leads to businesses from people starting their search off Yelp. AI-enhanced business owner inbox helps service pros better manage their leads Keeping track of leads and managing customer communications can be a challenge for local service pros. To simplify this, in the coming weeks, the business owner inbox will be redesigned to surface brief AI-powered summaries with crucial information about the job, allowing service pros to easily evaluate leads at a glance. By leveraging LLMs, we extract and highlight the most relevant information about a job, such as the location, project specifics, whether it’s a one-time job or regular service, and more. Seamlessly connect with service pros to complete your projects with new enhancements to Yelp Assistant and easy project editing and broadcasting, request quotes via Apple Maps, and business owners can benefit from a redesigned inbox that leverages AI to surface the most important information in leads. Harnessing AI to make ad set-up and optimization easier than ever We’re enhancing our product suite for businesses with new features designed to empower local business owners by simplifying ad setup and strengthening ad performance from day one. From AI-enhanced ad optimization to customizable competitive analytics and more options for support, we are committed to providing tools that help business owners achieve their advertising goals with ease. Smart selection leverages AI to optimize Yelp ads and strengthen performance Testing different ads to determine what resonates best with consumers can be time-consuming and require marketing expertise. To simplify this process, we’re introducing smart selection, an AI-powered feature for advertisers that automatically tests the best reviews and photos to showcase, optimizing their ad for the highest return on ad spend. When advertisers select “smart selection” during ad setup, Yelp will select, test, and optimize an ideal review and photo to help maximize the number of users it drives to their Yelp page, increasing their reach, and helping them meet their advertising goals. This free feature is available to all advertisers. Unlocking competitive insights and enhancing support We’re adding new options for competitive insights and support for local businesses with new features designed to simplify their advertising choices. Business owners looking to better understand how their page performance compares to others now have access to more customizable competitive data. The new page views dashboard in their business owner account enables them to compare their page views with up to three competitors of their choice in one view, helping to inform their own growth strategies. For advertisers who see significant fluctuations in their business due to seasonality, we’re introducing new ad budget options that allow them to temporarily reduce their ad spend during seasonal shifts with automatic restarts whenever it’s most convenient for them. Finally, our redesigned Support Center now features refreshed content tailored to businesses’ advertising status, simplifying how they find answers to their questions, underscoring our commitment to supporting business success with helpful resources. Advertisers can maximize their impact with the new AI-powered smart selection, which automatically recommends optimal photos and review text for Yelp ads, while business owners gain new insights by comparing their page visits against competitors of their choice. For two decades, Yelp has consistently elevated how you discover your next favorite spot or new go-to pro, building a vibrant community of locals supporting locals. From business summaries to Yelp Assistant , and now Review Insights, this year, we’ve introduced over 80 new features and harnessed the power of AI to transform the way you discover and connect with local businesses and service pros. Despite how far we’ve come, each exciting new innovation makes us feel like we’re just getting started and we can’t wait to show you what next year will bring. February 5, 2025 Share This At Yelp, we understand the significant influence online reviews have on people’s purchasing decisions, which is why we take extensive measures to maintain reliable and helpful content on our platform, putting consumer trust at the center of everything we do.
To further understand what makes online reviews helpful and trustworthy, we partnered with YouGov to survey over 2,350 review readers—individuals who’ve ever used online reviews of local businesses to guide their purchase decisions—uncovering valuable insights into consumer expectations and behaviors regarding local businesses and their reviews.
The survey reveals that consumers value authenticity and quality in online reviews, preferring detailed, firsthand experiences over just star ratings.
As reliance on reviews increases, people favor platforms that highlight genuine insights and prevent AI-generated, compensated, or incentivized reviews.
Our commitment to these principles aligns with consumer expectations, helping us maintain trust and reliability in the review landscape.
Consumers prefer detailed reviews from a variety of perspectives When making important spending decisions, whether for a special dining experience or hiring a professional for a kitchen remodel , people often rely on others’ recommendations.
In fact, 72% of review readers say they read more online reviews now than ever before to guide their local business purchase decisions.
Even as influencer reviews on social media become more prevalent, 88% of review readers still prefer seeing multiple opinions on review platforms over individual ones on social media.
Aggregated feedback on review platforms often provides a more accurate and comprehensive prediction of what to expect from a local business, allowing people to more easily discover feedback on specific topics about a business that matter most to them.
So what do consumers find most helpful when researching the right business?

However, not all review platforms take the same approach, for instance, Google allows star ratings without text.
Research from FTC Economist Devesh Raval found approximately 50% of Google reviews contain fewer than 100 characters, including 32% lacking text entirely.
In contrast, the same research found that only 2% of Yelp reviews had less than 100 characters.
As of December 31, 2024, the average length of recommended reviews contributed to Yelp was about 447 characters .
Consumers seek more than just a star rating—they want detailed experiences and insights from customers, which is why our guidelines emphasize quality over quantity.
Consumers want reviews written by actual customers—not AI Despite the rise of AI tools, 88% of review readers oppose AI-generated reviews on review platforms.
This aligns with our policies at Yelp, as we require all reviews to be based on genuine, firsthand experiences with a business, and reviewers must write their own reviews.
Since 2023, we’ve rolled out several new detection technologies powered by AI to help identify and mitigate AI-generated reviews, and we continue to enhance these efforts.
Consumers don’t tolerate compensated and incentivized reviews Reviews sought in exchange for compensation or other incentives aim to mislead consumers.
People strongly want review platforms to moderate these deceptive practices and disclose them when uncovered.
The survey found that 91% of review readers want platforms to disclose if a business has ever been the subject of suspicious review activity or other attempts to deceive consumers.
Additionally, 83% of review readers would avoid a business if they learned it had fake or compensated reviews.
In September 2024, the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) issued a final rule banning fake and incentivized reviews.
At Yelp, we not only align with this rule, but our policies go even further to address additional deceptive behaviors, such as prohibiting compensated and incentivized reviews altogether, attempts to suppress critical reviews , and more.

In this Spring Release we’re introducing: An even smarter Yelp Assistant with AI-powered photo recognition that automatically identifies and understands your project needs to connect you with the right pro .
AI-powered response quality badges that spotlight service pros who consistently provide helpful and informative replies .
A new lead management integration with Zapier , along with new measurement functionality for national services brands, helps pros seamlessly manage their leads.
An improved dining experience with new tools, like Guest Experience Survey , helps restaurants better manage front-of-house operations and gives you more control over your visit .
Our 2025 Spring Product Release marks the next step in our ongoing product transformation—one that’s grounded in using AI to deliver simplicity and efficiency in meeting your real-world needs.
We’re doubling down on AI-powered innovation to enhance trust and ease decision-making, always with the same mission in mind: helping you connect with great local businesses.
Today, we’re excited to introduce 15 new features and updates that simplify how you discover and hire pros, as well as enable restaurants to streamline their front-of-house operations.
New AI-powered response quality badges and Yelp Assistant photo recognition will give you more confidence in choosing the right pro and help you seamlessly complete projects.
We’re also releasing a suite of updates to help restaurants better manage their front-of-house operations and improve your diner experience—like automated Guest Experience Surveys and improved reservation management.
From making it easier to complete service projects to enabling smarter restaurant operations, these updates make Yelp more intuitive, and more helpful.
Representing the next step in Yelp’s AI transformation, we’ll soon begin testing AI-powered call answering services —one for restaurants and another for services—to help businesses stay connected when they’re busy or unavailable.
Both call answering services will be fully integrated into Yelp’s platform with customizable features, and the ability to answer general questions, filter spam, transfer calls when needed, and capture messages.
The solution for services will also collect details about your project and intelligently ask relevant questions to capture detailed leads for pros in their business owner account, while the restaurant solution will book reservations, add you to the waitlist, and seamlessly integrate into Yelp Guest Manager with access to call analytics.
By grounding our AI in real consumer behavior and business data, we’re creating intuitive, transparent features that improve the experience for everyone on Yelp.
Stay tuned for this exciting new development.

Enhancing Yelp Assistant with AI-powered photo recognition Since launching Yelp Assistant in 2024, we’ve continued to enhance it with new features and availability that make it easier to connect you with local pros.
Now, Yelp Assistant uses AI-powered photo recognition to automatically identify and understand your project needs.
Whether it’s an error code on your dishwasher, a dent in your car bumper, or a photo of your dream front yard makeover, there’s no need to type out long descriptions—just upload a photo related to your project and Yelp Assistant will pinpoint the service you’re looking for, ask relevant follow-up questions, and connect you with the right pros to complete your project.
Yelp Assistant photo recognition helps pros receive more accurate project details, leading to better connections and more precise quotes—making hiring easier and more efficient than ever.
Yelp Assistant photo recognition is currently available on iOS, with Android and desktop to come.
Discover helpful service pros with AI-powered response insights Once you connect with a pro, receiving clear and detailed responses is critical to making informed decisions—no matter who you’re hiring.
To address this need, we’re introducing AI-powered response quality badges to spotlight service pros who consistently provide helpful, informative replies to project requests.
Now, you can find response quality badges, like “Excellent,” on eligible business pages and on business listings in Yelp search results—making it easier for you to identify pros with a reputation for reliable and thorough communication.
AI-powered response quality badges spotlight service pros who consistently deliver helpful, informative replies to project requests.
We’re leveraging large language models (LLMs) to evaluate response quality based on a variety of factors, including whether the business owner provides a quote or availability, acknowledges project details, asks relevant follow-up questions, and goes beyond a generic “call us” reply.
Businesses need a minimum threshold of responses to generate a response quality score, which updates regularly based on recent replies.
Business owners can view their score in their Yelp for Business profile and will find guided prompts when replying to new leads to help them improve their response quality.
Response quality badges are currently displayed across all home, professional, local, auto, pets, event planning, real estate, and financial services categories on iOS and desktop in Arizona, Washington, Oregon, Illinois, and Indiana—with nationwide availability to come.

To simplify lead management, we’re integrating Yelp’s Leads API with Zapier , making it easier than ever to connect Yelp with your existing customer management system.
For services brands looking for a quick-to-market solution, the Yelp Leads Zapier app automatically syncs and manages leads within their existing workflows.

This Yelp is introducing more than 20 new updates that enhance the Yelp experience for our community of consumers and business owners, including: AI-powered business summaries that make it even easier to find a business that fits your needs with a quick glance.
Recognitions that celebrate and distinguish reviewers who are passionate about a specific food, cuisine or nightlife category.
A new visual home feed and search experience enhance discovery, helping you quickly and easily find your new favorite restaurant.
New updates to the services experience, such as enhancements to Request a Quote and new ‘Projects’ features, make it easier to find the right service professional for your needs, as well as quickly and efficiently get your projects done.
A revamped business owner experience that delivers valuable market and competitive insights, while AI-powered smart budgets provide useful recommendations to optimize ad spend, helping local businesses grow and better compete in their markets.
Reflecting back on 2023, we released more than 35 new features that bring more value to all of our users – from leveraging large language models (LLMs ) and other updates that ease decision making, to new features that help you hire a service pro with confidence, enhancements to the reviewing experience , and more.
Meanwhile, for business owners we leveraged AI to make setting up their ads easier and more cost effective.
And, for restaurant owners, we integrated with third parties to give our Yelp Guest Manager clients access to the largest restaurant consumer network in the U.S.
Now, as we kick off the new year, we’re excited to share our new Winter Release full of features that make life even easier.
Today, we’re announcing more than 20 new features and updates across the Yelp platform that make it more seamless and engaging for users to discover and connect with great local businesses in their community.
New AI-powered business summaries surface short, unique insights that detail what you can expect at a business; and fun, new Recognitions celebrate your helpful reviews.
You’ll also find a more visual and engaging home feed and search experience that brings local businesses to life, new features that make it easier than ever to connect and coordinate with service professionals that meet your exact needs, and more.
For business owners, we’re introducing new updates that help them operate more efficiently, better compete in their local markets, and grow their business.
Easing decision making with AI-powered business summaries that surface unique insights For years, we’ve leveraged AI to help reduce consumers’ decision paralysis — from spotlighting the most popular dishes and drinks , to using LLMs to power review highlights for more nuanced searches.
Now, new AI-powered business summaries leverage LLMs to parse recent reviews and describe what you can expect at the business, helping you quickly find a business that fits your needs at a glance.
At the top of restaurant, food and nightlife business pages, these unique summaries highlight what the business is best known for based on first-hand reviews from users — such as the atmosphere, service, amenities, value, or a popular dish.
AI-powered business summaries are available on iOS and will roll out to Android and desktop later this year.
Celebrating and supporting contributors with an enhanced review experience You deserve to be celebrated for taking the time to write reviews that help others in your community make informed spending decisions, which is why we’re rolling out new features that spotlight regular contributors, as well as expanding our interactive review topics to make it even easier to write rich and detailed reviews.
Recognitions celebrate your helpful contributions We’re rolling out a new way for you to earn Recognitions for writing reviews in the categories you’re most passionate about.
Today, you can earn more than 165 Recognitions across a variety of foods, cuisines and nightlife spots , including brunch, burgers, cocktails, coffee, ice cream, ramen, tacos, and more.
Recognitions are earned for writing at least three reviews within a year for businesses within the same select category and are featured in the ‘Achievements’ section on the ‘Me Tab’ in the Yelp iOS app.
In the coming months, Recognitions will also appear next to your reviews on business pages for the same category to further distinguish the contributors who are familiar with reviewing a particular type of restaurant, food or nightlife business .
Recognitions for additional categories and platforms will roll out later this year.

More review topics make writing helpful reviews even easier To further alleviate writer’s block when drafting a review, we’re expanding our interactive review topics to new categories across home, local, professional and auto services, as well as beauty, shopping, health and medical.
Review topics identify when common themes are covered in reviews — like the “care quality” at a doctor’s office or when someone writes about the “value” of a service provided from a contractor — to remind you of helpful details of your experience that other people would want to know about.
Review writing has never been more engaging with new Recognitions and interactive review topics in more categories.
Revamping the discovery experience to make it more visual than ever before We know that the hundreds of millions of photos and videos on Yelp play an important role in helping you decide what business is right for you.
Visual elements provide important insights on a business’s ambiance, services offered, or the food quality, which is why we’re rolling out new features and updates that spotlight high-quality visual content, to help you quickly and easily find great local businesses.
New AI-powered home feed highlights more relevant and visual content to users We’re introducing a new home feed experience on iOS that leverages AI to surface the most relevant photos from Yelp users and content from nearby businesses, encouraging the discovery of businesses near you.
In addition to relevant user photos, you can expect to see autoplay video updates from restaurant, food, and nightlife businesses via Yelp Connect posts, as well as Collections from Yelp Elites .
In the coming months, the homepage will also feature user videos and roll out on Android.
Revamped visual search experience brings business listings to life We’ve updated the entire iOS search experience with more visual components to help you easily find the right business for your needs.
From the start, you’ll find a new suggestions page that highlights popular and recent searches before you’ve even begun typing — helping you get started when you aren’t quite sure what you’re looking for or when you want to quickly pick up where you left off from a previous search.
Search results for restaurants, food and nightlife businesses will now feature photo-heavy search results listings, visually bringing businesses to life.
For frequently searched foods, you’ll find new carousels that highlight popular dishes, such as pizza, ramen, sandwiches and tacos, saving you time when you want to find if a business near you offers the dish you’re craving.

We’re also surfacing new ways for you to see which services businesses are backed by Yelp – in addition to filtering for Yelp Guaranteed businesses, you can now find the Yelp Guaranteed badge alongside eligible businesses when scrolling through business listings in search results. Phone leads help service pros close more leads To make it easier to book a job or schedule an appointment, businesses with Request a Quote enabled can now directly call or text potential customers that opt-into being contacted directly by the business. To protect user privacy, businesses receive a masked temporary phone number and users can opt-out at any time. Hiring a service pro has never been easier with new updates to the ‘Projects’ and Request a Quote experiences, as well as the nationwide availability of Yelp Guaranteed. New phone leads make it easier for business owners to coordinate directly with customers and close more leads. Enhancing the Business Owner Experience with AI and data-driven Insights In a highly competitive market, local businesses are constantly seeking new ways to stand out. Our latest product enhancements provide even more valuable insights to businesses on Yelp, equipping business owners with comprehensive competitive performance data and smarter ad budget recommendations , helping them make strategic, informed decisions to reach relevant consumers and grow their business. New data-driven Yelp for Business homepage enables business owners to make more informed decisions We’re introducing a new data-driven Yelp for Business homepage that shares enhanced performance, customer and competitor insights. The updated performance summary highlights a snapshot of a business’s success on Yelp, such as the number of impressions, pageviews, and leads a business has received. Customer insights detail audience data like what neighborhoods have the most consumers searching for the services they offer and the trending search terms in their area. New competitor insights provide performance comparisons detailing page visits over time compared to similar businesses, and the names of highly-viewed competitors. Enhanced onboarding experience with AI-driven insights sets you up for success We revamped the experience for new advertisers on Yelp, helping them better determine the right ad budget for their business , as well as easily improve their business page. AI-powered smart budgets, now leveraging neural networks , provide helpful advertising budget recommendations to businesses by taking into account numerous unique factors about their business — including their rating, category, listing age, region, and more — to help them select the advertising option with the highest potential ROI. In addition, the new “Getting Started” section helps bu sinesses set up their page for success with recommendations based on a predictive analysis of what will drive the most success, and the redesigned business Q&A section helps them quickly respond to public questions from consumers. Scheduled consultations provide more support for advertisers We’re introducing a new support option for advertisers to seamlessly get in touch with Yelp’s customer service team with scheduled consultations. Now, businesses can get instant support from Yelp when it’s most convenient for them, without needing to hold for a representative. The revamped Yelp for Business experience surfaces more insights and recommendations for business owners and advertisers. Scheduled consultations enable advertisers to reach Yelp support when it’s most convenient for them. To seamlessly access all these new features and more, we’re also rolling out an easy one-time login experience that allows you to simply enter a pin to access your account, including your ‘Projects’ messages. This year, as Yelp celebrates two decades of connecting you with great local businesses, we’re committed to building new features across the platform to better inform your spending decisions, as well as deliver more value to local businesses. We’re continuing to double down on new product updates that harness our rich, trusted content to elevate moments of discovery and inspire even more meaningful connections. With recent advancements in AI, you can expect to see us further leverage LLMs to ease the discovery experience, facilitate more seamless connections with service providers and help local businesses succeed. We can’t wait to share more on what we’ve been building. This Yelp is introducing a series of new features to enhance the consumer experience in our most significant update in recent years: Yelp Guaranteed, a new satisfaction guarantee that offers our Request a Quote users peace of mind when hiring home service professionals.
An enhanced search experience that leverages Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to help people connect and discover the right business for their needs.
Immersive video, interactive topics and new reactions in reviews make Yelp contributions even more engaging.
For nearly 20 years, Yelp has served as a community-driven platform that empowers you to discover and confidently connect with local businesses.
We’re always working to enhance this experience by building products and features that give you access to reliable and useful information, helping you decide where to spend your money and share your experiences with your local community.
Today, we’re excited to unveil a number of new features that make it even easier for you to discover businesses that fit your needs and contribute helpful content on Yelp.
A new satisfaction guarantee program, Yelp Guaranteed, will help you hire home service professionals with greater confidence.
An AI-powered search experience helps match you with the most relevant local businesses when you have a specific or nuanced need, and new discovery features help you find the right business when you’re not sure what you’re looking for.
To make reviews more visual and interactive, you will now be able to add video to reviews, write richer, more helpful reviews with greater ease and react to reviews in new ways.
Plus, we’re introducing more visual updates across the platform to help you better discover and connect with great local businesses within your community.
Yelp Guaranteed makes hiring home service pros a worry-free experience When looking to hire a professional for a home project, it’s easy to feel inundated with choices — comparing ratings, reviews, availability and pricing before settling on the right business.
To provide you with greater confidence and peace of mind during the hiring process, we’re rolling out Yelp Guaranteed , a new satisfaction guarantee program that will allow you to get up to $2,500 back in the event something goes wrong with your project.
When you hire a business through Yelp’s Request a Quote feature for an eligible project, you’ll automatically be enrolled in the program, allowing you to submit a claim if you run into challenges resolving an issue directly with the business — either because you’re not satisfied with the work performed, property was damaged related to the project or if the business was a no-show on a pre-paid job.
Yelp Guaranteed is currently available for eligible projects submitted through Request a Quote based on a variety of qualification factors.
You can now use a Yelp Guaranteed search filter to find businesses where your project will be covered.
You’ll also find “Covered by Yelp Guaranteed” below the Request a Quote feature on business pages, when the project is eligible.
Today, Yelp Guaranteed is available across the U.S. for popular home service categories on Yelp.
You can easily discover businesses where your project will be covered by Yelp Guaranteed by selecting the “Yelp Guaranteed” filter in search, as well as looking out for the Yelp Guaranteed badge surfaced on business pages and in your ’Projects’ tab .
Enhancing the search experience on Yelp leveraging LLMs and AI With the vast amount of rich user-generated content available on Yelp, we’ve long used AI to power solutions across our platform, including dish recommendations , organization of photos and automating content moderation , among others.
With the recent advancements in LLMs, we’re continuing to invest in further enhancing the search and discovery experience on Yelp to make it even easier for you to find businesses that fit your needs.
We’re announcing a number of the new search features today, which build on our investment in AI and LLMs to surface smarter search suggestions and power insights to help you find the right business.
By leveraging these technologies to analyze the vast amounts of our user-generated content, in the future we’ll be able to quickly, precisely and succinctly summarize insights and provide personalized recommendations based on your search intent.
Review highlights driven by LLMs make finding relevant businesses easier By leveraging LLMs, Yelp can better understand the nuance in your search intent and highlight relevant information from reviews in new snippets that appear under each business listing in your search results.
For example, when you search for “ tennis courts ” on Yelp, in addition to the list of parks and sports facilities that appear in your search results, you will also now see helpful review highlights about tennis courts under each park or facility listed, such as “there are tennis courts that you need to book in advance.”
AI-powered search suggestions help you easily find businesses anywhere We’re using AI to provide better search suggestions based on your search intent that are not bound by your location – helping you make plans for the future when you’re not looking for businesses near home, or go back to review a business you visited on a recent trip.
Yelp now suggests businesses that you may be looking for across the U.S., streamlining the discovery experience for when you already have a specific business in mind.
“Surprise Me” provides inspiration for where to eat When you’re having a tough time deciding where to eat, Yelp’s new Surprise Me feature combats analysis paralysis with restaurant selection.
An easy click on the red “Surprise me” button, found on the Yelp home feed and search results, will generate a unique highly-rated recommendation near you.
If the first recommendation isn’t for you, hit “Surprise me again” for a new suggestion.
More than one million businesses have already been suggested every month through this new feature.
Clickable category tags enhance discovery in search If you’re still not sure where to eat, clickable category tags on business listings for restaurants, food and nightlife searches, help you better refine your search and connect with the right business.
Yelp is using LLMs to enhance the search results with review highlights, as well as making it easier for you to narrow down your search with new clickable category tags and Surprise Me.
Revamping the review experience with new ways to contribute We’re introducing new visual and interactive ways for you to share your experiences with businesses, as well as new ways for you to engage with and react to reviews.
Videos in reviews Videos are a great way to capture and share your experiences — whether it’s of a steaming bowl of ramen, a new hike you discovered in your local park, or the view from a recent hotel stay.
To provide a unique inside look into your experience with the business, you’ll be able post high-resolution video up to 12 seconds alongside your text review and photos.
Review topics make writing helpful reviews even easier We know that sometimes you may develop writer’s block when crafting reviews.
To remind you what made your experience great when reviewing restaurant, food and nightlife businesses, we’re rolling out new interactive review topics – “food,” “service” and “ambiance” – that help you track what you’ve covered, and remind you of other topics you might want to address.
Once a topic is addressed it will automatically turn green with a checkmark at the top of your draft review.

Introducing more visual and seamless experiences across the platform We’re rolling out new features that better surface our rich, visual content and make it even easier to find the business information you’re looking for. These changes across the platform will help you make informed spending decisions that you can trust. Bringing video to Connect Yelp Connect is a paid feature that allows business owners to share important updates directly with consumers. We’re now empowering businesses to upload videos to their Connect posts, giving you more engaging content from the business — from a weekly deal, to special menu items, to upcoming events and more. New navigation and photo experience on business pages makes it easier to find what you’re looking for A new navigation bar on restaurant, food and nightlife business pages makes it easy for you to more efficiently find the information you’re looking for by jumping directly to a business’s menu, amenities, reviews, or other helpful information. We’ve also redesigned the photo viewing experience on business pages by introducing AI-driven photo categories for food and nightlife businesses, as well as a new sort feature that enables people to quickly see recently added photos. These updates allow you to easily find photos based on what you’re most interested in – such as the most recent menu photo and the different types of cuisines or dishes a restaurant has to offer. Relatedly, we’ve updated the look and feel of business photos on desktop with a new infinite vertical scrolling feature so you can easily view all the photos for a business. Surfacing more helpful information on the visual home feed The refreshed home feed now surfaces even more helpful information about local businesses near you, including the total review count of a business, how many other reviewers mentioned a Popular Dish in a positive review, the price of a menu item, your distance from a business and more. We plan to bring even more helpful information and visual contributions, including video, to the home feed this year. Passwordless login We’re rolling out a new login experience that won’t require you to remember your password every time you want to log into your account. Now, when you’re logging into Yelp, you will receive a unique email link that seamlessly and securely authenticates with just one click. This allows you to automatically sign in to submit your requests for quotes, create Collections , join a waitlist and more. Yelp has rolled out a variety of new features and visual updates that improve the user experience. These product updates demonstrate our significant investment in innovating and enhancing the consumer experience, so people can easily and confidently connect with great local businesses. Now and into the future, we’re focused on building solutions that better identify your nuanced needs, help you unquestionably hire service professionals and further instill trust in the information you find on Yelp. In the coming months, we will continue to build upon these new features, expand them to even more users and further leverage advanced technology, such as AI and LLMs, to enhance our platform. We look forward to sharing more on what’s to come soon. Additional assets and images from the announcement can be found here . In this Spring Release we’re introducing: Yelp Assistant, a new conversational AI feature that intelligently guides you through the process of finding the right pro for the job, transforming how you discover, connect with and hire service professionals.
Yelp Fusion AI API, enabling third-party partners to integrate Yelp’s trusted content into their products to create natural language search experiences.
Yelp Guest Manager enhancements that improve and streamline front-of-house operations, Waitlist and Kiosk updates to help guests get seated faster and more efficiently.
As Yelp approaches 20 years of connecting you with great local businesses, we’re continuously innovating to enrich your experience, whether you’re planning your next home project or looking for the perfect dining spot.
What began as a review site that millions of people relied on for finding great restaurants and other local experiences, has evolved into a powerful platform that helps you easily navigate the often complex task of finding and hiring service professionals.
Today, many of our users rely on Yelp to find the right service pro for their needs — in the first quarter of 2024, consumer interest in home services businesses was up nearly 30% compared to Q1 2019.
And now we’re leveraging AI to make that process even easier.
After recently announcing a series of new discovery, contribution, services and AI-powered features earlier this year, today we’re unveiling our Spring Product Release with more than 15 new features and updates that will transform the Yelp experience.
Our new AI-powered Yelp Assistant will revolutionize how you discover and connect with service pros.
For partners, the new Yelp Fusion AI API will allow third-party platforms to create natural language search experiences powered by Yelp content.
For restaurants, enhancements to Yelp Guest Manager will help them seat more diners by boosting front of house efficiency; and more.
Yelp Assistant transforms how you discover and hire services professionals with conversational AI
Whether you’re in need of quotes to repair your roof, looking to get your car detailed, or want to change up your hairstyle, Yelp Assistant, a new conversational AI feature, reinvents how you connect with and hire service professionals.
Powered by large language models (LLMs), Yelp Assistant intelligently guides you through the process of finding the right pro for the job.
It contextually understands your project or problem, engages in a professional-like dialogue with follow up questions, and then matches you with businesses that are qualified to help with your project.
Unlike any other solution available today, Yelp Assistant is able to efficiently translate your problem and identify the right provider for your needs because the LLM is trained on Yelp’s vast and reliable dataset, including Request a Quote, business information, and more, in addition to LLMs from OpenAI.
With its effective and precise matching capabilities, Yelp Assistant is delivering highly relevant, detailed leads to businesses, enabling them to more efficiently assess the project and get hired.
Yelp Assistant is a new conversational AI feature that redefines the way consumers connect with businesses across thousands of service categories within home, local, auto, beauty, and more.
Yelp Assistant not only helps you connect with pros who are suited for your project, but it also alleviates the guesswork on the type of specialists you may need, making hiring the right pros straightforward and stress-free.
Once you let Yelp Assistant know what project or issue you’re looking to solve, it quickly springs into action with a personalized conversation to collect the necessary details a pro would need to evaluate your project.
You have the option to either craft your own replies, choose from a selection of convenient one-click responses, or ask it a question to help further refine your response.
After you review and approve the final project request, Yelp Assistant then creates and sends detailed project submissions to relevant service providers on your behalf, enabling businesses to better respond with accurate pricing and availability.
Yelp Assistant can connect you with businesses across thousands of categories within home, local, auto, beauty, pet, real estate, professional, event planning, financial services, and more.
It’s currently available on iOS from the ‘Projects’ tab and will roll out to Android later this summer.

This summer, we’ll refine Project Ideas with predictive analysis to provide you with more personalized Project Ideas, recommendations and checklists.
Plus, service pros will find business owner inbox enhancements that help them quickly respond to and secure jobs.
New Saved Replies, currently available on iOS, allow business owners to effortlessly create and save response templates for common questions.
They’ll also be able to stay more organized with updates that distinguish new leads from previously contacted messages, and new city location tags that easily identify the service area.
Project Ideas help inspire your next endeavor, and new inbox enhancements help business owners quickly respond to and secure jobs.
Yelp Fusion AI API brings natural language search to third-party partners Third-party partners can now integrate Yelp’s trusted content into their products to create conversational AI experiences with the new Yelp Fusion AI API.
For years, Yelp Fusion has enabled consumers to access Yelp’s high quality information on local businesses in other places across the web, on mobile and in cars and homes.
Our new LLM-powered partner solution, Yelp Fusion AI API, enables innovative user experiences using natural language search, even if partners have no previous AI products or experiences.
Utilizing Yelp’s reliable local data and content — including business information, reviews and photos — the Yelp Fusion AI API enhances discovery on third-party platforms by enabling conversational queries like, “Find a vegan brunch place with a patio that’s open this Sunday at 10:00 a.m.,” or, “Recommend a good gym in Miami that has a swimming pool.”
The AI will provide responses that are contextual to the conversation, sharing relevant businesses with detailed information, including Yelp ratings, review highlights , photos, business summaries , and more.
This new solution not only benefits partners by enabling conversational engagement using Yelp content, but it also reduces their need to acquire and manage data, ultimately making it easier and more efficient for their users to find great local businesses.
The Yelp Fusion AI API represents a significant advancement in our mission to connect people with great local businesses, by opening new possibilities for these connections to be made seamlessly both on and off of Yelp.
The Yelp Fusion AI API is currently available for partners to integrate into their platform, and non-partners can test out the AI API with 30-day access or contact us to learn more.
Today, the Yelp Fusion AI API supports single-turn questions and responses, with multi-turn conversations coming later this year.
The Yelp Fusion AI API helps partners integrate natural language search experiences into their own platforms.
Enhancing the Restaurant Experience with Yelp Guest Manager Yelp Guest Manager , our comprehensive front-of-house solution, gives more than 11,000 restaurants access to the largest diner network.*
Now, with new features that streamline front-of-house operations, enhance analytics for restaurant owners, and improve Yelp Waitlist and Kiosk, restaurants can boost efficiency, seat more diners, and improve guest experiences.
Revamped Yelp Guest Manager provides hosts with smarter insights We’re introducing a new suite of features for Yelp Guest Manager that provide hosts with a deeper understanding of their guests’ needs, enabling more effective staff utilization, better preparedness for upcoming shifts, and streamlined operations.
Cover Flow makes it even easier to plan for and manage the dinner rush by helping hosts better optimize server sections and table assignments, and monitor table status in real time.
Party Highlights empower staff to create more personalized and attentive guest experiences, while Shift Notes streamline front of house communication by centralizing information for staff.
Plus, credit card holds for in-house reservations just got easier with automated SMS confirmations sent to guests, eliminating the need for hosts to manually enter credit card information.

New user permissions, rolling out in the coming weeks, provide restaurant owners and general managers with more precise control over staff access to Yelp Guest Manager features, getting the right tools into the right hands. With online reservation management, restaurants can now create reservations and assign tables without having to use the host app. These new updates are available in the Yelp Guest Manager business owner account s on desktop. And in the coming months, restaurant owners will have access to new traffic attribution analytics that detail valuable cover and booking trends. New Waitlist updates improve wait time accuracy and diner communication Yelp Waitlist has made it easier than ever for diners to join the waitlist at their favorite restaurants from anywhere, while freeing up host time to focus on other important front-of-house operations. Wait time accuracy continues to improve with AI through our use of neural networks to help diners better plan their restaurant outings. In addition to more accurate wait times, new text message place-in-line updates, such as if the line is moving faster or slower than anticipated, mean there’s no need for diners to keep an eye on the app or ask when they’ll be seated. Soon, diners will also receive texts to check out popular dishes before they’re seated. Hosts can automate updates or send them manually, simplifying diner communication and helping them seat guests faster, reducing table turn times. Redesigned Yelp Kiosk enhances the diner check in experience Yelp Kiosk just got a new look. This newly redesigned experience makes it easier to join the waitlist and check yourself in when you’re at the restaurant, streamlining the process for diners while allowing the host to manage other front-of-house operations. Shift Notes (left), Table Usage Analytics (center) and new text message place-in-line updates (right) streamline front-of-house operations, boost efficiency and improve communication amongst staff and guests. Our mission to connect people with great local businesses has never been more relevant. February 28, 2024 Share This Yelp’s mission is to connect consumers with great local businesses by giving them access to reliable and useful information.
Consumer trust is one of our top priorities, which is why Yelp has extensive Trust & Safety measures that utilize advanced technology and human moderation to protect the integrity and quality of content on our platform.
Today, we’re releasing our 2023 Yelp Trust & Safety Report , which outlines the various ways we mitigated attempts to mislead consumers, including efforts that were orchestrated off of Yelp.
You’ll learn about our automated recommendation software and the ways we combat compensated and incentivized reviews, including our index of Consumer Alert recipients .
We also share our extensive efforts to remove inappropriate content and bad actors from our platform, which include leveraging large language models (LLMs).
This year’s report also looks at how we moderate business pages that gain public attention, the actions we take to protect consumers from abuse of the legal system, and more.
Of the 22 million reviews that were contributed to Yelp in 2023, approximately 20% were either not recommended by our recommendation software or removed by our User Operations team as a result of our extensive trust and safety measures.
*
Recommending the most helpful and reliable reviews Yelp’s automated recommendation software helps surface the most helpful and reliable content to consumers by evaluating all reviews on our platform based on hundreds of signals of quality, reliability, and user activity.
The software is engineered to not recommend reviews that may be unfairly biased (e.g., written by people likely affiliated with the business or potential competitors) or otherwise potentially unreliable.
One of the policies that differentiates Yelp from other platforms is that we don’t allow businesses to ask for reviews , even if no compensation changes hands, which is something the recommendation software is engineered to detect.

Surfacing helpful information and removing potentially inappropriate content on Yelp Yelp’s User Operations team investigates content and platform activity through proactive and reactive moderation efforts.
They implement a variety of measures that help protect our users and their safety, whether it’s mitigating hate speech, misleading information, or other forms of inappropriate and unhelpful content.
In 2023, our User Operations team closed 278,600+ user accounts for violating our Terms of Service, including engaging in suspected deceptive or abusive behaviors.
At Yelp, we rely on our community of consumers and business owners to report reviews that they believe violate our Terms of Service and Content Guidelines .
Our User Operations team investigates all flagged content and, if it’s found to be in violation of our policies, will remove it from the platform.
In addition to relying on reports from our community of users and business owners, Yelp began using LLMs to proactively detect reviews that may contain inappropriate content before it’s ever published to our platform.
The system flags these reviews to our moderators who evaluate the content, which helps make a determination to further inform the LLM.
Since determining whether content is inappropriate can be context specific, we also continue to rely on reports from the Yelp community.
Incorporating LLMs to detect inappropriate content has enabled our moderators to prevent 23,600+ reviews from ever appearing on Yelp.
In addition, our User Operations team removed 28,800+ reported reviews for containing threats, lewdness, hate speech, and other potentially inappropriate content.
Each time a new business is added to the Yelp platform, our User Operations team verifies these submissions to thwart spammy or deceptive businesses from appearing.
In 2023, an increase in new business page submissions resulted in 40,700+ potential new business pages being rejected by our User Operations team for being associated with spammy behaviors that violate our policies — up 24% year-over-year.
Relatedly, we removed 1,500+ business pages for being associated with lead generators, or attempts to create fake business pages with the goal of generating leads and auctioning them to other contractors.
Moderating business pages that gain public attention When a business gains public attention, consumers may come to Yelp to express their opinions through reviews.
However, Yelp’s Content Guidelines require that all reviews reflect genuine, firsthand consumer experiences.

Our moderators conduct thorough investigations by scouring businesses’ websites, social media pages, “About the Business” information contributed to Yelp by the businesses themselves, Yelp reviews from consumers, and more. We’ve continued to regularly audit and investigate these businesses – in 2022 alone, we have proactively evaluated nearly 33,500 U.S. business pages and recategorized nearly 470 business pages as Crisis Pregnancy Centers (as of August 8, 2022). Yelp’s moderators are continuing these investigations in the coming months, with plans to evaluate a total of 55,000+ business pages across the U.S., Canada and Puerto Rico. We take transparency seriously, especially around sensitive healthcare decisions. These updates further demonstrate Yelp’s commitment to maintain the trust and safety of our users, and quality and integrity of the information we provide them. This At Yelp, we remain committed to connecting people with businesses that best address their individual needs and preferences .
This includes introducing eco-friendly attributes for those looking to patronize establishments that prioritize sustainability, as well as enabling businesses to indicate if they’re Open to All or if they have gender-neutral restrooms , which are important for consumers who want to feel safe and welcomed.
While “wheelchair accessible” is among the most popular attributes on Yelp business pages, we recognize that accessibility needs vary for the more than 42 million Americans with disabilities .
To better serve the community, ahead of Disability Pride Month in July, Yelp has teamed up with disability inclusion leaders Disability:IN , the American Association of People with Disabilities (AAPD) ,
Open to All , and The Arc to introduce new searchable accessibility attributes.
These attributes will make it easier for users to find businesses that meet their mobility, hearing, and vision accessibility needs.
We’re also rolling out platform updates for people with visual impairments, including AI-powered alternative text for photos to improve the experience for people using screen readers.
Additionally, we’ve created a new Accessibility Resource Hub for businesses, which offers information and tools to help business owners implement and learn more about inclusive practices for customers with disabilities.
Introducing more accessibility business attributes Yelp users are increasingly looking for businesses that accommodate accessibility needs, with “wheelchair accessible” searches rising an average of 40% from 2020 to 2023.
To further meet this growing need, today, we are introducing eight new business attributes that cater to specific accessibility needs and provide users with reliable and helpful information before visiting a business.
In addition to our existing wheelchair accessible attribute, consumers can now identify businesses that provide accommodations for the following mobility, hearing and vision accessibility needs.
Mobility Accessibility Attributes Accessible parking near entrance: These businesses must have accessible parking spaces, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (ADA) , that allow individuals with mobility disabilities to easily access the business without needing to go a significant distance.
ADA-compliant main entrance: According to ADA standards , these businesses must have a ramp, elevators, or no steps/stairs at their entrance, as well as a door with a clear opening width of at least 32 inches when the door is opened to 90 degrees.

“Far too often, people with disabilities do not have access to information to find businesses and services that are accessible to them,” said Calla Devlin, managing director of Open to All.
“Yelp’s new suite of attributes is an invaluable tool for customers, and Open to All offers resources and guidance for businesses to create welcoming and safe environments for all customers.
We’re thrilled to partner again with Yelp to create a world where businesses truly are open to all.”
Business owners can add these attributes to their Yelp page for free by logging in to their Yelp for Business account and editing their “Business Information” section.
We’re also surveying consumers about these attributes through the “Update the community” questions on Yelp business pages.
Leveraging AI to enhance the accessibility of Yelp for users with visual impairments To continue to make Yelp more inclusive, user-friendly, and accessible, we’re rolling out new improvements throughout the app and website to better support people with visual impairments, including AI-powered alternative text descriptions for photos, improved color contrast, and other enhanced screen reader functionality.
Without captions, people who rely on screen readers to interpret web content may miss out on the context and details of a photo.
To bridge this gap, we are now leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically generate descriptive alternative text for images for screen readers to leverage on restaurants, bars, and nightlife business pages.
Whether it’s a restaurant’s most popular menu item or a bar’s signature cocktail, AI-powered alternative text descriptions make this information available to more users as they decide which local businesses to try next.
AI-powered alternative text descriptions are available on desktop today and will roll out across all platforms and categories in the future.
Additionally, we’ve enhanced the overall screen reader experience for users, including improved navigation across the platform.
We’ve also improved color contrast to help make our content more legible to users with low vision or colorblindness.
While we’ve made progress in enhancing accessibility on our platform, we’re continuously evolving Yelp to improve the experience for consumers and businesses and through our dedicated accessibility design team, our commitment to enabling access to all users is ongoing.
Supporting inclusive businesses Incorporating inclusive practices to address diverse accessibility needs can significantly benefit individuals with disabilities.
There are several ways to improve accessibility, some of which can be relatively easy for business owners, such as updating signage or adding a QR code menu.
To support business owners in creating more inclusive spaces, Yelp’s new Accessibility Resource Hub offers valuable information and tools from disability inclusion leaders, including American Association of People with Disabilities (AAPD) , Disability:IN , Open to All , and The Arc .

We remain committed to investing in programs and policies that empower and foster equal opportunities for individuals of all abilities, both within our organization and for the wider communities we serve. These new attributes and resources are just part of our ongoing efforts to support the disability community. We look forward to continuing to prioritize this work as we focus on improving and maintaining a platform that empowers and supports individuals of all abilities.
